multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: all 24 journey slices are integrated in every stage

checks.proves: Partner, store, catalog, and cross-surface bindings remain connected.
checks.doesNotProve: It may not prove database and native evidence behavior.
checks.failCriteria: Any missing writer-reader link or parallel truth fails.

checks.proves: Backend partner, store, onboarding, readiness, and persistence logic pass focused tests.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove surface UX or real provider behavior.
checks.failCriteria: Any failure, skipped required test, or race fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: create or update partner, store, evidence, catalog proposal, assortment, and status, then verify partner, control-panel, client, captain, and field readback
checks.proves: Cross-surface state converges from authoritative sources.
checks.doesNotProve: Requires seeded actors and runtime services.
checks.passCriteria: All authorized readers show correct state and unauthorized readers show none.
checks.failCriteria: Any stale, copied, cross-scope, or unbound result fails.
